issue.title: ClassCastException in @ParameterizedTest: Base Class from Different Class Loader
issue.body:
**Describe the bug**
Running a `@QuarkusTest` fails with a `java.lang.ClassCastException`, see [MWE](https://github.com/schulzp/quarkus-classcast-mwe).

**Expected behavior**
The tests passes.

**Actual behavior**
When using `@ParameterizedTest` with `@MethodSource`, see [MWE](https://github.com/schulzp/quarkus-classcast-mwe), the test fails with the following exception:
`java.lang.ClassCastException: class org.hamcrest.core.Is cannot be cast to class org.hamcrest.Matcher (org.hamcrest.core.Is is in unnamed module of loader 'app'; org.hamcrest.Matcher is in unnamed module of loader io.quarkus.bootstrap.classloading.QuarkusClassLoader @7188af83)`

However, if the test parameters are [mapped manually](https://github.com/schulzp/quarkus-classcast-mwe/blob/master/src/test/java/com/example/ExampleResourceTest.java#L28) (using a regular `@Test`) it passes.

**To Reproduce**
Steps to reproduce the behavior:
1. Check out the [MWE](https://github.com/schulzp/quarkus-classcast-mwe)
2. run `./mvnw verify`

**Configuration**
```properties
# no properties are set explicitly
```

**Environment (please complete the following information):**
 - Output of `uname -a` or `ver`:
   ```
   Darwin Kernel Version 19.3.0; root:xnu-6153.81.5~1/RELEASE_X86_64 x86_64
   ```
 - Output of `java -version`: `11.0.1, vendor: Oracle Corporation`
 - Quarkus version or git rev: `1.3.1.Final`
 - Build tool (ie. output of `mvnw --version` or `gradlew --version`): 
   ```
   Apache Maven 3.6.3 (cecedd343002696d0abb50b32b541b8a6ba2883f)
   Java version: 11.0.1, vendor: Oracle Corporation, runtime: [...]
   Default locale: de_DE, platform encoding: UTF-8
   OS name: "mac os x", version: "10.15.3", arch: "x86_64", family: "mac"
   ```
**Additional context**
The behavior occurred when I upgraded quarkus from 1.2.1.Final to 1.3.0.Final/1.3.1.Final.

issue.title: QuarkusTest throws exceptions when having parameters in test function
issue.body:
**Describe the bug**
When having a test function with parameters injected, QuarkusTest throws `java.lang.IllegalArgumentException: argument type mismatch` exception

**Expected behavior**
Maybe it should work with parameters injected.

**Actual behavior**
```argument type mismatch
java.lang.IllegalArgumentException: argument type mismatch
	at java.base/jdk.internal.reflect.NativeMethodAccessorImpl.invoke0(Native Method)
	at java.base/jdk.internal.reflect.NativeMethodAccessorImpl.invoke(NativeMethodAccessorImpl.java:62)
	at java.base/jdk.internal.reflect.DelegatingMethodAccessorImpl.invoke(DelegatingMethodAccessorImpl.java:43)
	at java.base/java.lang.reflect.Method.invoke(Method.java:566)
	at io.quarkus.test.junit.QuarkusTestExtension.runExtensionMethod(QuarkusTestExtension.java:433)
	at io.quarkus.test.junit.QuarkusTestExtension.interceptTestMethod(QuarkusTestExtension.java:334)
	at org.junit.jupiter.engine.execution.ExecutableInvoker$ReflectiveInterceptorCall.lambda$ofVoidMethod$0(ExecutableInvoker.java:115)
	at org.junit.jupiter.engine.execution.ExecutableInvoker.lambda$invoke$0(ExecutableInvoker.java:105)
	at org.junit.jupiter.engine.execution.InvocationInterceptorChain$InterceptedInvocation.proceed(InvocationInterceptorChain.java:106)
	at org.junit.jupiter.engine.extension.TimeoutExtension.intercept(TimeoutExtension.java:149)
	at org.junit.jupiter.engine.extension.TimeoutExtension.interceptTestableMethod(TimeoutExtension.java:140)
	at org.junit.jupiter.engine.extension.TimeoutExtension.interceptTestMethod(TimeoutExtension.java:84)
	at org.junit.jupiter.engine.execution.ExecutableInvoker$ReflectiveInterceptorCall.lambda$ofVoidMethod$0(ExecutableInvoker.java:115)
	at org.junit.jupiter.engine.execution.ExecutableInvoker.lambda$invoke$0(ExecutableInvoker.java:105)
	at org.junit.jupiter.engine.execution.InvocationInterceptorChain$InterceptedInvocation.proceed(InvocationInterceptorChain.java:106)
	at org.junit.jupiter.engine.execution.InvocationInterceptorChain.proceed(InvocationInterceptorChain.java:64)
	at org.junit.jupiter.engine.execution.InvocationInterceptorChain.chainAndInvoke(InvocationInterceptorChain.java:45)
	at org.junit.jupiter.engine.execution.InvocationInterceptorChain.invoke(InvocationInterceptorChain.java:37)
	at org.junit.jupiter.engine.execution.ExecutableInvoker.invoke(ExecutableInvoker.java:104)
	at org.junit.jupiter.engine.execution.ExecutableInvoker.invoke(ExecutableInvoker.java:98)
	at org.junit.jupiter.engine.descriptor.TestMethodTestDescriptor.lambda$invokeTestMethod$6(TestMethodTestDescriptor.java:205)
	at org.junit.platform.engine.support.hierarchical.ThrowableCollector.execute(ThrowableCollector.java:73)
	at org.junit.jupiter.engine.descriptor.TestMethodTestDescriptor.invokeTestMethod(TestMethodTestDescriptor.java:201)
	at org.junit.jupiter.engine.descriptor.TestMethodTestDescriptor.execute(TestMethodTestDescriptor.java:137)
```


**To Reproduce**
Steps to reproduce the behavior, simple reproduce test below:
In order to use [`VertxExtension`](https://vertx.io/docs/vertx-junit5/java/), I need to inject `VertxTestContext` in my test function:
```
@ExtendWith(VertxExtension::class)
@QuarkusTest
class simpleTest {
    @Test
    fun myTest(vertxTestContext: VertxTestContext) {
           testContext.verify { }
     }
}
```
I can create a new instance of `VertxTestContext` in the test, but will lost the benefit of its context and need to do some workaround to verify the test etc.

**Environment (please complete the following information):**
 - Output of `uname -a` or `ver`:  `Darwin Kernel Version 19.4.0`
 - Output of `java -version`: `openjdk version "11.0.6" 2020-01-14`
 - GraalVM version (if different from Java): 
 - Quarkus version or git rev: `io.quarkus:quarkus-bom:1.3.2.Final`
 - Build tool (ie. output of `mvnw --version` or `gradlew --version`):  `6.0.1`
 - Vertx-junit5 version: `3.8.5`

issue.title: ClassCastException when using pact-jvm Jupiter extension and @QuarkusTest
issue.body:
**Describe the bug**
We're using [Pact-JVM](https://github.com/DiUS/pact-jvm) to specify and test consumer driven contracts.
We implement those tests by running Junit Jupiter tests with a combination of `@QuarkusTest` and Pact-JVM Jupiter extensions.

Unfortunately since Quarkus `1.3.0.Final` those tests will fail because of `ClassCastException`. 
After a short research I've seen that those exceptions will be thrown, because the test encounters multiple ClassLoaders.
It seems that the different stages of the Pact Jupiter extension lifecycle are running with a different ClassLoader than the tests itself. So there is an incompatibility between the shared objects (parameters given from the extension into the `@Test` method).

When we use Quarkus `1.2.1.Final` everything works fine.
The issue still appears when we use Quarkus `1.4.1.Final`.

**Expected behavior**
When using Pact-JVM Jupiter Extension and `QuarkusTest` there should be no ClassCastException.

**Actual behavior**
When using Pact-JVM Jupiter Extension and `QuarkusTest` there will a ClassCastException be thrown.

**To Reproduce**
Steps to reproduce the behavior:

Clone this repo
`$ git clone git@github.com:tgippi/quarkus-pact-issue.git`

Run the tests either with `1.3.2.Final` or with `1.4.1.Final`:
`$ mvn -P1.3 clean test`
or
`$ mvn -P1.4 clean test`

See that there will a ClassCastException be thrown.

**Configuration**
No explicit configuration.

**Screenshots**
Shouldn't help explaining the problem.

**Environment (please complete the following information):**
 - Output of `uname -a` or `ver`: 
```
Linux localhost.localdomain 5.5.5-200.fc31.x86_64 #1 SMP Wed Feb 19 23:28:07 UTC 2020 x86_64 x86_64 x86_64 GNU/Linux
```
 - Output of `java -version`: 
```
openjdk version "11.0.6" 2020-01-14
OpenJDK Runtime Environment 18.9 (build 11.0.6+10)
OpenJDK 64-Bit Server VM 18.9 (build 11.0.6+10, mixed mode, sharing)
```
 - GraalVM version (if different from Java):  No GraalVM
 - Quarkus version or git rev: Every version since `1.3.0.Final`
 - Build tool (ie. output of `mvnw --version` or `gradlew --version`): 
```
$ mvn --version
Apache Maven 3.6.3 (cecedd343002696d0abb50b32b541b8a6ba2883f)
Maven home: /opt/maven
Java version: 11.0.6, vendor: Oracle Corporation, runtime: /usr/lib/jvm/java-11-openjdk-11.0.6.10-0.fc31.x86_64
Default locale: de_DE, platform encoding: UTF-8
OS name: "linux", version: "5.5.5-200.fc31.x86_64", arch: "amd64", family: "unix"
```
